verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages for search, extract, crawl, map, research, usage and logs, served as clean Markdown for agents. Its docs include copy-paste code examples, and keyless SDK mode lets search/extract examples run without an API key. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-browser interactive 'try it' playground, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-docs request console/playground, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of runnable reference examples.
